panels.title: Sampled operations
panels.description: Count of observed operations selected for dual reads in the chosen period.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="scorearc",event="scorearc_reader_comparison",service="frontend"} | json type, cohort | __error__="" | type="operation" | cohort="sample" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Comparable reads
panels.description: Reads that returned sufficiently complete results from both providers to establish agreement or disagreement.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="scorearc",event="scorearc_reader_comparison",service="frontend"} | json type, outcome | __error__="" | type="read" | outcome=~"match|mismatch" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Disagreement with ESPN
panels.description: Mismatched reads divided by matched plus mismatched reads. An empty result means there were no comparable reads.

targets.expr: 100 * (sum(count_over_time({job="scorearc",event="scorearc_reader_comparison",service="frontend"} | json type, outcome | __error__="" | type="read" | outcome="mismatch" [$__range])) or vector(0)) / (sum(count_over_time({job="scorearc",event="scorearc_reader_comparison",service="frontend"} | json type, outcome | __error__="" | type="read" | outcome=~"match|mismatch" [$__range])) > 0)

panels.title: ESPN fallbacks
panels.description: Sampled operations ultimately served by ESPN in the chosen period.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="scorearc",event="scorearc_reader_comparison",service="frontend"} | json type, cohort, served | __error__="" | type="operation" | cohort="sample" | served="espn" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Sampling rate
panels.description: Sampled operations as a percentage of sampled plus control operations. News runs outside the experiment.

targets.expr: 100 * (sum(count_over_time({job="scorearc",event="scorearc_reader_comparison",service="frontend"} | json type, cohort | __error__="" | type="operation" | cohort="sample" [$__range])) or vector(0)) / (sum(count_over_time({job="scorearc",event="scorearc_reader_comparison",service="frontend"} | json type, cohort | __error__="" | type="operation" | cohort=~"control|sample" [$__range])) > 0)

panels.title: Sampled read outcomes by endpoint
panels.description: Count per interval. An ESPN failure makes the comparison inconclusive. News and control reads do not contribute.

targets.expr: sum by (endpoint, outcome) (count_over_time({job="scorearc",event="scorearc_reader_comparison",service="frontend"} | json type, endpoint, outcome | __error__="" | type="read" | outcome=~"match|mismatch|reader_error|inconclusive" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Operations by cohort and source served
panels.description: Each joined operation counts once. The decision explains why an operation fell back or failed.

targets.expr: sum by (cohort, served, decision) (count_over_time({job="scorearc",event="scorearc_reader_comparison",service="frontend"} | json type, cohort, served, decision | __error__="" | type="operation" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Sampled read errors by provider
panels.description: Logical provider failures per interval with error category and available HTTP status. A read can record evidence from both providers.

targets.expr: sum by (endpoint, readerError, readerStatus) (count_over_time({job="scorearc",event="scorearc_reader_comparison",service="frontend"} | json type, outcome, endpoint, readerError, readerStatus | __error__="" | type="read" | outcome=~"reader_error|inconclusive" | readerError!="" [$__interval]))

sum by (endpoint, espnError, espnStatus) (count_over_time({job="scorearc",event="scorearc_reader_comparison",service="frontend"} | json type, outcome, endpoint, espnError, espnStatus | __error__="" | type="read" | outcome=~"reader_error|inconclusive" | espnError!="" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Reader usability by endpoint
panels.description: Percent of completed sampled logical reads that returned a reader result without a reader dependency fault. Includes ESPN failures and mismatches. An interval with no measured reads has no rate.

targets.expr: 100 * avg_over_time({job="scorearc",event="scorearc_reader_comparison",service="frontend"} | json type, cohort, endpoint, readerResult | type="read" | cohort="sample" | readerResult=~"usable|unavailable" | label_format usable=`{{ if eq .readerResult "usable" }}1{{ else }}0{{ end }}` | unwrap usable | __error__="" [$__interval]) by (endpoint)

panels.title: Reader attempts by endpoint
panels.description: Count of completed sampled logical reads behind the usability rate. A join can contain several reads. ESPN-only controls and news make no reader attempt.

targets.expr: sum by (endpoint, readerResult) (count_over_time({job="scorearc",event="scorearc_reader_comparison",service="frontend"} | json type, cohort, endpoint, readerResult | type="read" | cohort="sample" | readerResult=~"usable|unavailable" | __error__="" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Oldest observed resource at read time
panels.description: Maximum seconds since the ESPN observation when a sampled reader resource was checked, including cached responses and stale observations rejected by the reader policy. Finalized and unknown clocks appear in the evidence counts.

targets.expr: max_over_time({job="scorearc",event="scorearc_reader_resource",service="frontend"} | json endpoint, resource, clock, freshness, ageSeconds | clock="observed" | unwrap ageSeconds | __error__="" [$__interval]) by (endpoint, resource, freshness)

panels.title: Reader resource evidence at read time
panels.description: Counts of validated resource checks. One logical read can check multiple resources. Finalized takes precedence when both clocks exist. Missing observation and finalization clocks appear as unknown. Failed requests without resource metadata contribute only to the logical read panels.

targets.expr: sum by (endpoint, resource, clock, freshness, availability) (count_over_time({job="scorearc",event="scorearc_reader_resource",service="frontend"} | json endpoint, resource, clock, freshness, availability | __error__="" [$__interval]))

panels.title: ESPN feed changes
panels.description: Up to 100 distinct changes first seen or last recorded in the selected window. Inspection covers valid roster and biography JSON up to 2 MiB. Fragments are limited to 1 KiB. The example and competition come from the first sighting. Repeat sightings update at most once per UTC hour. Queue, quota and write warnings appear in the ingester logs. Biography requests use one competition namespace for players across all editions.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT endpoint AS "Endpoint", path AS "Field path", kind AS "Change", detail AS "Detail",
       first_competition AS "First request competition", example::text AS "First example",
       first_seen_at AS "First seen", last_seen_at AS "Last recorded", observed_hours AS "Observed hours"
FROM public.espn_feed_change
WHERE $__timeFilter(first_seen_at) OR $__timeFilter(last_seen_at)
ORDER BY CASE WHEN $__timeFilter(last_seen_at) THEN last_seen_at ELSE first_seen_at END DESC, endpoint, path, kind, detail
LIMIT 100

options.content:
CI writes recorded ESPN responses into Postgres and reads them back through ScoreArc HTTP handlers.

- [Team roster → squad response](https://github.com/mcasillas17/ScoreArc/blob/main/backend/reader/reader_contract_integration_test.go)
- [Player biography → career response](https://github.com/mcasillas17/ScoreArc/blob/main/backend/reader/players_integration_test.go)

[Check the backend job for the main commit](https://github.com/mcasillas17/ScoreArc/actions/workflows/ci.yml?query=branch%3Amain). Replay coverage is independent of live traffic and the dashboard time range.

panels.title: Endpoint failure rate
panels.description: Failed HTTP attempts divided by completed attempts at each boundary. Cancellations are excluded; HTTP 200 responses with body failures count as failures.

targets.expr: 100 * avg_over_time({job="scorearc",event="scorearc_http"} | json direction, dependency, method, endpoint, outcome | outcome!="" | outcome!="cancelled" | label_format failure=`{{ if eq .outcome "success" }}0{{ else }}1{{ end }}` | unwrap failure | __error__="" [$__interval]) by (service, direction, dependency, method, endpoint)

panels.title: Endpoint errors by status and cause
panels.description: Failed attempts per interval with the observed HTTP status, failure type, and application code when available.

targets.expr: sum by (service, direction, dependency, method, endpoint, status, outcome, appError) (count_over_time({job="scorearc",event="scorearc_http"} | json direction, dependency, method, endpoint, outcome, status, appError | __error__="" | outcome!="" | outcome!="success" | outcome!="cancelled" | label_format status=`{{ if .status }}{{ .status }}{{ else }}no_response{{ end }}` [$__interval]))

panels.title: Endpoint latency · p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of recorded request durations at each boundary, including failed and cancelled attempts.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {job="scorearc",event="scorearc_http"} | json direction, dependency, method, endpoint, durationMs | unwrap durationMs | __error__="" [$__interval]) by (service, direction, dependency, method, endpoint)

panels.title: Endpoint request volume
panels.description: Observed HTTP attempts per interval, including cancellations and retries. Frontend and Go service boundaries are separate series.

targets.expr: sum by (service, direction, dependency, method, endpoint, outcome) (count_over_time({job="scorearc",event="scorearc_http"} | json direction, dependency, method, endpoint, outcome | __error__=""  [$__interval]))

panels.title: Ingester · latest match polls
panels.description: Current latest poll per competition and season, across rolling and full polls. This snapshot stays visible when the ingester stops.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT competition_id AS "Competition", season_id AS "Season", outcome AS "Latest result",
       attempted_at AS "Last attempt", succeeded_at AS "Last success", event_count AS "Matches"
FROM public.match_poll_status
WHERE source = 'espn'
ORDER BY succeeded_at ASC NULLS FIRST, competition_id, season_id

panels.title: Ingester · recent runs
panels.description: Latest 100 runs starting inside the selected time range. Open runs have no completion time.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT started_at AS "Started", competition_id AS "Competition", kind AS "Job",
       CASE WHEN ok THEN 'ok' WHEN ok IS FALSE THEN 'failed' ELSE 'open' END AS "Result",
       round(extract(epoch FROM finished_at - started_at)::numeric, 2) AS "Duration (s)"
FROM public.ingest_run
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
ORDER BY started_at DESC
LIMIT 100

panels.title: Ingester · unresolved match recovery
panels.description: Current pending or failed recovery records by provider, including how many have reached their next retry time.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT source AS "Provider", last_error AS "State", count(*) AS "Matches",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE retry_at <= now()) AS "Retry due",
       min(last_attempted_at) AS "Oldest attempt"
FROM public.match_sync_status
WHERE last_error IN ('pending', 'recovery_failed')
GROUP BY source, last_error
ORDER BY "Retry due" DESC, source, last_error
